name: Takara Sushi Pork or Chicken Katsu Don Egg & Rice Bowl
whyItWorks: Simmering the breaded chicken or pork cutlet with egg and sweet soy-dashi broth over steamed white sushi rice softens the breading and makes it much gentler than dry fried cutlets.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken or Pork Katsu Don over steamed white rice and ask for light or no sliced onions in the egg simmer.
watchOuts: Cutlet is panko-breaded and fried before simmering—for a 9.5/10 flare-safe meal at Takara, order Plain Udon Noodle Soup or Salmon Nigiri instead
